meta.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: original photo-quality editorial banner for a university creators discussion community, landscape 16:10, approximately 1600 pixels wide. This is a GENERIC CONCEPT PHOTOGRAPH, never a documentary photograph of a real campus or named event.
Scene: a sunlit pale oak collaboration table in a neutral indoor space, close crop of the tabletop only. No buildings or identifying scenery.
Subject: the quiet moment in an informal student maker conversation. Show only TWO natural adult hands/forearms from different sides: one resting by an open cream notebook, the other lightly pointing toward a small original unbranded wooden geometric prototype on the table. One clean blue pen, a pair of round white ceramic cups near the top edge, simple blank paper idea cards and warm saffron and blue pieces. Keep the scene sparse and meaningful, realistic rather than staged stock-photo cliché. Paper has only extremely faint nonverbal sketch lines, no readable words or math.
Style: exceptionally warm, tactile, honest editorial lifestyle photography; no faces, no named identities, no unrealistic objects. Medium top-down oblique camera angle, real skin texture, accurate fingers and proportions, oak grain, linen shirt cuff. Soft large-window illumination from the upper left, gentle shadows and warm highlight roll-off.
Composition: most of the interaction and objects occupy the upper-right and center-right; the left quarter and lower-left foreground of the oak desk are comparatively quiet with clear space for a headline added in HTML. Keep central prototype and hands readable in a centered mobile crop.
Color: creamy oak, warm white, restrained saffron ochre, slate blue. Joyful intellectual collaboration without neon.
Constraints: no words, numbers, letters, logos, watermarks, interfaces, visible faces, school insignia, buildings, actual event references, faux news reportage, deformed hands, extra fingers, clasped or tangled fingers, clutter, business handshake, floating objects, fluorescent light, heavy bokeh blur. Full bleed, no frame.

Use case: stylized-concept.

Scene/backdrop: quiet midnight charcoal studio darkness, subtly visible dark optical breadboard surface only near the lower-right.
Subject: a finely machined satin-silver microscope objective/optical lens barrel held by a compact precision adjustment mount, looking toward a pristine small clear optical prism on a black metal post. One extremely delicate restrained blue-violet line of illumination connects the apparatus and refracts into the prism, with a very small highlight. A second soft-focus circular glass lens farther behind adds depth, but no busy lab clutter. Keep geometry coherent, believable mount screws and fine knurled adjustment ring, clear optical glass and precise polished edges.
Style: photography-grade luxury industrial still-life, rich true material detail, elegant restraint, carefully composed, dark and tactile. This is a generic research concept object, not a named experiment or validated optical setup.
Composition: apparatus concentrated in the center-right and upper-right; leave the left 40% and lower-left foreground near-black and calm for future white Chinese text. Wide cinematic framing, subject big and readable, enough clear margins and useful centered-right portrait crop.
Lighting/color: silver-metal specular highlights, ice blue and a trace of soft violet in glass, a narrow cool studio key, rich dark shadows. No warm fire colors.
Avoid: any words, labels, numbers, symbols, logos, watermark, UI, glowing icons, particle clouds, lens flares, exaggerated laser beams, impossible rainbow shafts, fake equations, floating parts, robot hands, people, science-fiction screens, oversized toy microscope, actual campus background. No copied product design. Full bleed, no border.
